item.title: Iran’s US chemical weapons compliance concerns remain unresolved: Ambassador

item.title: In photos: Tehran census takers record households in Pasdaran in 1986
item.description: Census takers visit households in Tehran’s Pasteur neighborhood to collect information during the 1986 national population and housing census. The fourth national census, the first conducted after the Islamic Revolution, began simultaneously across Iran on October 8, 1986, and continued through October 22. IRNA’s archival photos show the census being implemented on its first day.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86285881/In-photos-Tehran-census-takers-record-households-in-Pasdaran

Census takers visit households in Tehran’s Pasteur neighborhood to collect information during the 1986 national population and housing census. The fourth national census, the first conducted after the Islamic Revolution, began simultaneously across Iran on October 8, 1986, and continued through October 22. IRNA’s archival photos show the census being implemented on its first day.

item.title: Hakim Nezami Historical School in Iran
item.description: Built in 1908 in Iran’s northern city of Astara, Hakim Nezami School has been transformed into a specialized museum showcasing the region’s history, culture, and educational heritage. The historic school once welcomed renowned figures, including Nima Yooshij, widely regarded as the father of modern Persian poetry.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86285812/Hakim-Nezami-Historical-School-in-Iran

item.title: Iran envoy: US attacks damaged 111 petrochemical, pharmaceutical facilities
item.description: London, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to the Netherlands and Representative to the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) has said that US military attacks on Iran’s chemical industries damaged 111 petrochemical and pharmaceutical facilities, disrupting supply chains and affecting the implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86285592/Iran-envoy-US-attacks-damaged-111-petrochemical-pharmaceutical

London, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to the Netherlands and Representative to the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) has said that US military attacks on Iran’s chemical industries damaged 111 petrochemical and pharmaceutical facilities, disrupting supply chains and affecting the implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention.
